conventions.difference: treatment minus status quo, CRN-paired by ensemble member (ForkService.compare paired=True); Student t 95 % interval over pairs
conventions.arm_interval: Student t 95 % interval of the arm mean over members (not paired)
conventions.fractions: mc, fmc, nmcs, nmcm, nmcd are fractions of the window (0-1) for the one tail
conventions.kpi_scope: each scenario's world holds one tail (preview per-tail worlds), so KPIs are that tail's

modes.oracle: not reported; used once per scenario only to validate bitwise continuation

S3.title: TJ105 tyres at 7 of 8 landings: requisition 2 tyres for the base (AGENT)
S3.status_quo: ScheduledPolicy scheduled/1.0.0 at every 08:00 IST decision epoch, no extra orders
S3.treatment: ScheduledPolicy scheduled/1.0.0 + the orders below, issued at the epoch

decision_context.lever_choice: REQUISITION_SPARES raises base stock (M18 _o_requisition_spares -> supply demands); WASH_SERVICE TYRES only resets M10 tyre pressure-loss states (servicing), it does not renew tyre landing life, so it is not the lever for a hard-time tyre change
decision_context.priority_choice: MCM (lead-time multiplier 1.5; M18 replenishes consumed spares at MCM); ROUTINE would map to PHU (2.5x), AOG (1.0x) is reserved for an aircraft on ground
